entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Patna
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Mr. Siya Ram Shahi, learned counsel for the petitioners submits that in the ceiling proceeding, by order dated 5.2.2001, the Collector released 23.22 acres of land with respect to the petitioners.

In view of section 4 of the Land Acquisition (Bihar Amendment) Act, 1979 (at page no.88), which provides for the compensation payable on the land subsequently released from the proceedings under the Ceiling Act, learned counsel submits that an award should have been determined as per the said section and paid.
As per instructions, neither any award has been prepared nor payment made as per section 4 of the said Amending Act.

2. Learned counsel for the respondent-State submits that the petitioners have received compensation as calculated on the basis of the provisions as laid down under section 3 of the Amending Act and further on request of the petitioners, the Patna High Court CWJC No.3993 of 2018(14) dt.05-05-2023 matter has already been referred to the competent civil Court, Madhepura,
under section 18 of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894.

3. In response, learned counsel for the petitioners submits that reference under section 18 of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894, requires preparation of the award and the person interested not having accepted the same.
Firstly, no award has been prepared.

It is further submitted that the counter affidavit is absolutely silent with respect to payment of compensation to the petitioners as per section 4 of the Amending Act and appropriate directions be issued.

entities.text: Santosh Kumar Bhuwania And Anr vs The State Of Bihar And Ors
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
Let respondent nos. 2 and 3 file their specific counter affidavit answering the following:-
I) Whether an award has been prepared in the land acquisition proceeding with respect to the petitioners and in case the same has been prepared, to bring on record a copy thereof.
II) In case, the same has not been prepared then how the respondents have referred the matter under section 18 of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894, to the competent civil Court?
III) The respondents will also bring on record the calculation for the compensation of the petitioner in accordance with the Land Acquisition (Bihar Amendment) Act, 1979 and the manner in which the same has been received by the Patna High Court CWJC No.3993 of 2018(14) dt.05-05-2023 petitioners.
IV) The counter affidavit will specifically state whether the calculation of the compensation has been done taking into account section 4 of the Land Acquisition (Bihar Amendment) Act, 1979.

V) The counter affidavit will be personally sworn by the Land Acquisition Officer,
Madhepura (respondent no.3).
5. Let the original records be handed over to learned counsel for the respondents.

6. Put up this case on 26.6.2023, at the same position.
(Partha Sarthy, J) avinash/-
